tool.name: list_running_clients
tool.description: List running 1С client sessions (with optional infobase / clientType filter)

tool.name: run_client
tool.description: Launch a 1С thin or thick client process against an infobase

tool.name: stop_client
tool.description: Stop a running 1С client session by sessionId (graceful → force-kill on timeout)

tool.name: list_launch_configurations
tool.description: List EDT launch configurations of type 'Клиент 1С:Предприятия': name, project, infobase, client type, user (passwords never returned)

tool.name: run_launch_configuration
tool.description: Launch an EDT launch configuration (1С client or debug) exactly like the IDE run/debug button — credentials and platform version come from the configuration
